summary: Implemented `in` membership for namespace types in rdflib/namespace.py: Namespace.__contains__ does a prefix test via ref.startswith(str(self)); ClosedNamespace.__contains__ returns any(ref == uri for uri in self.__uris.values()), so _RDFNamespace inherits it. Added tests in test/test_namespace.py covering prefix membership (positive and negative), SH, RDFS (defined term, undefined term sharing the base, plain string and Literal negatives), RDF (rdf:type), and the container property rdf:_1 (False). Added imports for RDF, RDFS, SH, Namespace, and Literal. Nothing was run, per instructions; verification was by reading only. Nothing was committed.
